newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle lower, feeders up at new high.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle lower, feeders up at new high.

text.p: CME live cattle futures opened mixed but turned mostly lower early while May feeder cattle rose to post another new high, as expected.
Trade was uneven in live cattle ahead of the cattle-on-feed report. Feeders ran up following another sharp rise in the index and expected lower CBOT corn futures, traders said.

At 0908 CDT, live cattle stood unchanged to 0.075 cent lower, with June unchanged at 65.500 cents a lb. Feeders were up 0.350 to 0.025, with August up 0.200 at 77.600 cents. May was up most after setting a new high of 77.600 cents.
